Above the 85.6% baseline but far below the 92% entry-deterioration line — this is the standing entry-quality state, NOT a new deterioration and NOT an exit-ownership shift (that needs <=70%).

Precheck reports BTC 'AT EMA300 chop-pin 74m'. Flip rate 21 agg / 24 BTC per 24h — inside the normal band (p50 20, p95 26), NOT anomalous. Volatility LOW, volume LOW, velocity SLOW: quiet consolidation pin, not a trend tape. No blanket direction steer justified; conditions only. 

OPEN TRADES — both thesis-valid, hold with conditions: (1) BTC LONG continuum-trend+ @80267, meta_rsi 53.2: aligned with 1m-above-EMA300 tape (2.3h). SL 79353 (-1.14%), TP 81471 (+1.5%). Invalidation: 1m closes below continuum EMA300 (~80121) for 15-30min. (2) AIXBT SHORT volume-buildup- @0.018394, meta_rsi 72.7, +0.08%: fading a hot pump — the HIGH-RSI short cell is the measured winner: volume-buildup SHORT meta_rsi>=65 over 14d = 4/4 100% WR, +$0.44, avg MFE 1.23%. Current +0.08%. Invalidation: 1m RSI holds >70 and price accepts above SL 0.018785. 

WRONG-SIDE AUTOPSY (24h hard_max_loss cluster): DYDX SHORT -5.45% (meta_rsi 37.9, MFE 0.23), LTC SHORT -3.82% (37.3, MFE 0.10), BLUR LONG -4.19% (57.9, MFE 0.04). All entered AFTER the move had happened and never armed trail. The oversold shorts (LTC/DYDX rsi~37): the dump was over — shorting oversold handed the trade to the bounce. WINNING side = the early trail shorts that caught the dump in progress (DOT #16429 +1.19%, LTC #16415 +0.82% at the SAME RSI band) or standing aside. 7d oversold shorts (meta_rsi<45) overall: 25T -$0.07, WR 56%, but 5 hard_max_loss tails — small wins, big misses, negative asymmetry. BLUR LONG mid-band 57.9 pump-chain+ into the pin: MFE 0.04, never moved — winning side was the short or nothing. 

WHAT'S WORKING: every 24h winner reached +0.40% MFE and exited via trail family (ugb_pt / profit-monster-trail / manual_trail): MFE range 0.38-0.85. continuum-trend+ 75% WR (8T), volume-buildup- 65.7% WR (35T +$0.43). The system still wins when trades arm; it bleeds on entries that never reach the trail. 

AI TRADER: no pick this cycle. Only NEAR SHORT cleared precheck, but with death-zone RSI 51.7 advisory + RR grade D (0.66) + chop-pin — exactly the mid-band chop entry that feeds the 86% never-armed bleed. AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False (CEO 2026-10-19) so watchlist-only regardless; not worth the line.
